manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up and falls back. A motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and reverses, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball rises from a launch mark on a fixed height scale. The blue Motion arrow shortens, disappears at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
